title: HEAVENLY JUMPSTYLE
lyrics:
[00:00.000] 作词 : John Kell
[00:01.000] 作曲 : John Kell
[00:15.123]Stay with me
[00:16.987]Please don't leave
[00:18.734]Say you need me,need me
[00:20.467]Cause I can't breathe,can't breathe
[00:22.526]Stay with me
[00:24.276]Don't let go
[00:26.010]If you leave me,leave me
[00:28.269]I'll be alone,alone
[00:29.954]Left with the light on,hoping you'd call
[00:31.730]Talking to shadows on my wall
[00:33.488]Told all my friends I'm doing fine
[00:35.263]Truth is I'm broken all the time
[00:37.339]Coffee goes cold,your name on my tongue
[00:39.164]Evеry old love song sounds like us
[00:40.913]Checkеd my phone,nothing from you
[00:42.937]How did forever fade so soon?
[00:45.881]If you don't love me—say it,say it
[00:48.414]Stay with me…
[00:54.315]Please don't leave
[00:55.763]Say you need me,need me
[00:57.606]Cause I can't breathe,can't breathe
[00:59.384]Stay with me
[01:01.227]Don't let go
[01:02.943]If you leave me,leave me
[01:05.136]I'll be alone,alone
[01:06.867]Hangs by the door
[01:08.091]Count the cracks across the floor
[01:09.827]Every "we'll talk" turned into air
[01:11.613]You were beside me—now you're not there
[01:13.691]All of our plans in cardboard dreams
[01:15.416]Packed in a box that no one sees
[01:17.286]I play our nights back frame by frame
[01:18.989]Searching for when you slipped away
[01:21.581]Stay with me
[01:23.353]Please don't leave
[01:25.227]Say you need me,need me
[01:26.987]Cause I can't breathe,can't breathe
[01:28.827]Stay with me
[01:30.588]Don't let go
[01:32.695]If you leave me,leave me
[01:34.662]I'll be alone,alone…
